description: Return the x402 payment challenge (v1 JSON body plus, when the server sends it, the decoded v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header as paymentRequired) needed to top up credits for an existing agent endpoint. Accepts either a dashboard PAT with mcp:endpoints:write or mcp:* or a legacy endpoint API key.

accessToken.description: Your dashboard MCP personal access token (sgl_pat_*). Can be omitted when the connection sends Authorization: Bearer sgl_pat_*

slug.description: Slug of the endpoint to top up

name: request_endpoint_topup_payment
